subject: Re: KubeCon — scheduling demo & timezone clarification
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@acme-cloud.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: KubeCon — demo during conference / timezone question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for offering to squeeze in a demo during KubeCon. We (Acme Cloud) will be on-site Oct 14–16 and would love a 30–40 minute walkthrough of the Redwood inference platform while I'm there.

Two quick things I want to flag — we've run into timezone headaches before when booking on-site: my calendar defaults to EDT at home, but the hotel room system and some conference tools show local time (Europe/Paris / CEST). I don't want us to end up an hour off.

Are you able to propose two times on Wednesday Oct 14 in Europe/London or Europe/Paris local time? Our preference is late afternoon local time (around 14:30–16:00 local), but we can be flexible.

I've attached a short doc with what we'd like to cover (high level). If easier, we can book a slot in the KubeCon meeting area — I'll coordinate.

Best,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Head of Cloud Platform
Acme Cloud
Attachment: acme-requirements.pdf

Hi Michael — thanks for the note and the doc, looks great.

Quick note on timezones: IASI (my flight) lands in London late Tuesday so I'll be operating on Europe/London time from Wednesday morning, but our calendars are mostly in US/Pacific. To avoid confusion I'd like to do the following:

- Propose two concrete slots in Europe/London time and send invites with the timezone set to Europe/London (so your calendar should convert correctly regardless of where your laptop thinks you are).
- Please confirm whether the times in your hotel app are showing CEST or local time — some hotels in the KubeCon host city show the city timezone while others use your profile timezone.

Proposed slots (Europe/London):
- Wed Oct 14, 14:00–14:40 BST
- Wed Oct 14, 15:30–16:10 BST

Aditya — can you send the calendar invite (Europe/London timezone) once Michael confirms which works? I'll prepare a short 20–25 minute demo + Q&A and attach the agenda.

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

See you there.

Quick travel note for on-site folks: if you use the hotel app, double-check whether it lists times in CEST vs BST — for KubeCon Europe the conference center is operating on local time (CEST), while the nearby hotels sometimes advertise either CEST or your profile timezone. We recommend using the calendar invite (Europe/London) as the source of truth and checking your calendar app's timezone conversion.

See you Wednesday in the expo hall — we'll bring a laptop and the demo will be 20 minutes + 15 minutes for Q&A/next steps.
